subject: rename dataframe with int column names

messages.author: 9676a88bcd2419b9
messages.subject: rename dataframe with int column names
parts:
Example

require(dplyr)
require(tidyr)

data.frame(rowid=sample(1:10,50,replace=TRUE),colid=sample(1:4,50,replace=TRUE)) %>% unique(.) %>%
mutate(value=runif(n())) %>% spread(colid,value) %>% rename(k=rowid,p=1)

The above example works fine when the p=1 is removed from rename.  Obviously I can do colname(df) <- c(...) after the dplyr operation.  I was wondering if it was possible to use rename.

Thanks.
